notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control at least one basic Forest, or the land card in your hand is a basic Forest.
easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Dryad Arbor.
description:
Play any land from your hand, ensuring to play a basic Forest if you have one in hand.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers three times.
Holding priority, activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Dryad Arbor token, untapping the basic Forest.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one additional time.
Resolve the first and second Springheart Nantuko triggers, choosing not to pay and creating six 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 3.
